admission_assessment: No other concrete blocker found in this bounded source review. Exact historical DTO/source identity is checked before checkpoint byte access/model load; only two pinned checkpoint identities can execute once each per worker context. The new context cannot enter imitation, REINFORCE or gradient APIs and does not relax the default SynthStrip model gate.

controls.scope: Metadata and orchestration/refusal only. No patient arrays, checkpoint payload loading, policy forwards, tasks, native previews, gradients or optimizer steps.

findings.evidence: The independent test_terminal_checkpoint_failure_closes_running_method returned a failed top-level result but methods.initial.status was running instead of failed.
findings.issue: A failed active checkpoint method retains status running in a terminal failed result.
findings.minimal_fix: Set each still-running method status to failed and outputs to None; leave prior completed methods and not-started later methods intact.
findings.severity: Bounded terminal accounting defect; cannot manufacture top-level success or admit a different source.

semantics: One historical initial annotation-assisted TRAIN DTO is reused for two checkpoints. Estimated unreviewed support, supplied target annotation, hypothetical cavity/access, simulator-feasibility-filtered candidate inventory and horizon/crop/tool shift remain explicit. This tests frozen-input checkpoint compatibility, not anatomy admission, scan-only deployment, action safety, outcomes or real transfer.
